symptom: After opening a vacation result and changing dates, the page could show a full blank transition and a deal message that no longer matched the selected stay.
expected_behavior: Vacation business pages open in the current application tab, keep a stable loading surface, and show availability and price only for the current dates and guest count.
environment: v785 public behavior reproduced from the 2026-11-03 screen recording; repair candidate built from source 37d91c9b3970047d9386c598d63153a095713441 on Windows production build.

steps: Change the stay dates on the business page.
Compare the deal banner with the active booking summary.
reproduction.evidence: The supplied video shows a solid blank frame during the result-to-business transition and an old deal state beside the newly selected dates.

observations.observation: The business page rendered both HomeDealDetailStatus and VacationBookingHub as independent dated state owners.
observations.evidence: Pre-fix app/business/client-page.tsx contained both components, while HomeDealDetailStatus combined initial source and period with mutable dates.

observations.observation: The global navigation policy forced /business links into a new tab.
observations.evidence: Pre-fix app/lib/new-tab-policy.ts included /^\/business/ and browser DOM showed target=_blank on vacation result links.

observations.observation: Exact result hrefs retained their vacation IDs.
observations.evidence: DOM inspection returned /business?id=vacation-* links; the accessibility tree had only omitted the query in its compact display.

hypotheses.mechanism: Two independent dated availability surfaces allowed immutable deal context to remain visible after the active stay changed.
hypotheses.prediction: Removing the duplicate deal surface leaves one quote keyed to site, dates, guests and room selection.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect component ownership and run the transient-state and booking-mode contracts.
hypotheses.result: HomeDealDetailStatus was removed; VacationBookingHub is the sole dated surface and all focused contracts passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier API itself returned contradictory dates.
hypotheses.prediction: Contradictory values would remain after eliminating the duplicate UI owner.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Trace the quote key and compare supplier quote state with the duplicate deal component inputs.
hypotheses.result: The supplier quote is keyed to the complete current stay; the contradiction originated in the duplicate UI context.

hypotheses.mechanism: Forced new-document navigation created the full blank transition.
hypotheses.prediction: Keeping vacation business links in the App Router removes target=_blank and preserves a stable route-loading surface.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the live DOM policy and execute the new-tab and transient navigation contracts.
hypotheses.result: The candidate has no target on vacation business links, removes stale target attributes, observes later target mutations, and all navigation contracts passed.

hypotheses.mechanism: Search cards lost their business IDs during catalog hydration.
hypotheses.prediction: Exact href attributes would become /business without an id.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Read exact DOM href attributes after live catalog hydration.
hypotheses.result: Exact hrefs retained valid vacation IDs; only the compact accessibility representation omitted query strings.

fix.change: Removed the duplicate deal-status owner, kept vacation business navigation in the current tab, actively clears cached target attributes, and made the global route-loading surface viewport-stable.
fix.evidence: Thirteen focused contracts passed, the production build completed, and clean-origin DOM verification showed one booking hub, zero duplicate deal status nodes and zero target=_blank business links.

affected_family: Vacation business pages entered from home deals and search
Date and guest changes on the vacation booking hub
Cached browser sessions carrying the previous new-tab policy

regression_checks.check: Focused transient-state, booking-mode and new-tab contracts

regression_checks.evidence: pnpm build completed and verify-rsc-assets reported manifestsAgree=true with 229 references.
Business links retained vacation IDs with target=null; the page contained one VacationBookingHub and no HomeDealDetailStatus.

authorization_boundary: Authorized repair and one production publication; no database, supplier data, environment, DNS, domain, schedule, permission or AWS changes.
